body: One precision before you shape the smart constructors: make the validated fact values shared by both ParserSetupFailure and its public ParserFailure mirrors. Otherwise RuntimeArtifactMissing(Vector.empty) remains forgeable after setup is fixed. The same family includes the pre-existing RuntimeDependencyUnpinned(Vector.empty) and InvalidRuntimeField with a blank path; if the Unavailable ADT is being closed now, leave no structurally identical false case behind. A single validated RuntimeUnavailability reason carried through setup, failure, decision, and receipt would avoid duplicated raw fields.
